Public code isn't always open source.

Open source means the code is public and its license lets you use, change and share it. A public repo with no license is a different story: by default, you don't have permission to reuse it.

Always check for a LICENSE file.

📁cool-project
✓ MIT License

Free to use, modify and share.

📁other-project
⚠ No license

No permission to reuse by default.
